1. Scope

This license applies to all original code and original documentation owned
by VoVanRusLvSC2 in SC2Editor-MCP-Codex (the "Software"), across every project
module. This includes original editor/MCP functions, authoring tools, project
integration, original renderer settings and implementation, renderer adapters
and lighting code. It covers copies, modified versions and incorporated
portions of that original Software.

Third-party implementations, including vendor/blizzard-models, native vendor
libraries, imported Surface Toolkit core/format code, upstream schemas and
third-party data, are excluded. Their own licenses and copyright notices
remain in force. Changes to third-party code that are governed by its license
remain governed by that license. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and CREDITS.md.
This license does not grant rights to StarCraft II software or game assets.

4. Project attribution

Every project that incorporates the Software or uses it as a software component,
in whole or in part,
including modified modules or copied code fragments, must include a clear
credit identifying VoVanRusLvSC2 and SC2Editor-MCP-Codex as the source of the
modules or code used. Identify the modules or functionality actually used.

Place the credit in the project's README, CREDITS, documentation credits or
an About/Credits section. For a publicly distributed or publicly accessible
project, including a hosted service, this credit must be publicly accessible
to its users or readers of the project documentation. For a private project,
retain the credit in its project documentation; this condition does not
require making the project or its source public.

Merely operating the authoring tools to create or edit a map, document or data
does not apply this license to that output, unless the output itself contains
the Software or a portion of its code.

The credit must include the following information, or an equivalent
translation with the same meaning:

"Uses [identify modules or functionality] from SC2Editor-MCP-Codex
by VoVanRusLvSC2.
https://github.com/VoVanRusLvSC2/SC2Editor-MCP-Codex"

Preserving a copyright notice only inside a source file, or privately
notifying the author, does not by itself satisfy the project-credit condition.
Do not remove or conceal the required credit from incorporated versions.
Modified versions must not be represented as the author's unmodified work,
and attribution must not imply the author's endorsement.
